sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/14 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/place for PlaceId 14 and search/grid for facilities 75 Burson Electric/Water, 77 Creekside, 79 Royal Oak, start date 2027-05-04, read 2026-10-21)

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/hungry-mother ('Burson EWS (30 electric, water and sewer hookup sites in Camp Burson only ...) ... accept outlets for 20, 30 and 50-amp current'; Creekside 'accept outlets for 20 and 30 amp current (50-amp current available at Camp Burson only)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 80 campsites: Camp Burson (1 mile before the main entrance) has 30 electric/water/sewer and 20 electric/water sites, 'most sites will hold 25 to 35 feet, but larger sites are available', back-in with limited pull-throughs; Creekside has 19 paved electric/water sites, no RVs over 30 ft, with a very sharp turn on the access road; Royal Oak's 11 sites are tent-only. The booking site lists vehicle lengths of 25-85 ft in Burson and 22-30 ft in Creekside. Two vehicles per site besides the camping unit.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/hungry-mother ('Total campsites: 80 total in the park; 50 of which are in Camp Burson', site-type descriptions, 'Two vehicles per campsite in addition to a camping unit allowed') + reservevaparks.com search/grid VehicleLength for facilities 75 and 77, read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All reservations are made for a specific site.' Reserve online or at 1-800-933-PARK. Camp Burson guests check in at the Camp Burson office (daily Memorial Day-Labor Day, weekends through October), otherwise at the Discovery Center.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/hungry-mother ('Hungry Mother allows guests to reserve specific campsites. All reservations are made for a specific site', 'you can reserve online or call 1-800-933-PARK'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Year-round camping is in Camp Burson; the park page states it for that campground only.

season.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/hungry-mother ('Camping is available year-round in the Camp Burson campground'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed year-round camping (Camp Burson) and reservable by specific site; fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12. Added 50-amp electric with water and sewer (Burson EWS sites), 80 sites (69 for RVs) with limited pull-throughs. Not stated: max rig length as one figure, facilities beyond 'Bathhouse', booking window/cutoff for this park (left inherited), fcfs.
flags: Missing operator website: DCR's park page https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/hungry-mother (the entry's website is only the booking site).
